records.name: ngram 2.0
records.tagline: Create explainers, screencasts, and AI avatar videos
records.description: Turn ideas, documents, and recordings into narrated videos. ngram analyzes uploaded videos and screen recordings to identify key moments and build clear product walkthroughs. Create animated explainers or add an AI avatar presenter, then refine your video in chat.

records.name: SquadRoom
records.tagline: AI employees that work 24/7
records.description: SquadRoom gives you a team of AI employees. A lead agent learns your company and plans the work. Specialists for research, writing, partnerships and operations do it. You drop a task on the board and walk away. When you come back, the work is finished and a report shows every step and every source. Agents only stop to ask you when a decision really needs you, and nothing goes out without your OK. Bring your own AI key. Try the live demo, no signup.

records.name: Invited - AI Reminder Scanner
records.tagline: AI reminder scanner for bills, invites & documents
records.description: Invited is an AI reminder scanner that turns bills, invitations, cheques, screenshots and PDFs into smart reminders. It extracts dates, times, places and amounts, supports 80+ languages and 9 calendars, and finds multiple reminders in one document.

records.name: Codemind
records.tagline: Delegate coding. Get back code that works.
records.description: Your coding agent hands Codemind a task over MCP. It writes the code, tests it against your criteria and returns the files. $0.10 per verified build, failed builds free, free allowance to start.

records.name: Hexis Cloud
records.tagline: One company brain for all your AI agents
records.description: Hexis is one company brain for your team and all its AI agents. Through Hexis, your team can align on shared context that's important to align on, non-technical teams can work and collaborate on skills and your team can have hundreds of tools accessible via one MCP gateway. All the information is owned by someone, meaning it's context you can trust, and Hexis enables access control to a single file. It only takes a few minutes to set up, and is free for up to 3 people. Would love your feedback!

records.name: Understory Notes
records.tagline: Notes that tell the tale
records.description: Understory is a Mac notes app for people who take notes in order to write something. Collect notes as you read, arrange them into an outline, and draft each section with your research beside it. Then publish as a PDF, Rich Text, Markdown or a website.

records.name: Google EmbeddingGemma 2
records.tagline: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
records.description: EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind's open embedding model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space, so you can search across them from a single query. At 740M parameters it runs on-device, needing about 567MB of RAM on a Pixel 11 Pro for the full multimodal model (191MB for text only). Apache 2.0 licensed, with weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle. MTEB Code score rises from 68.76 to 78.68.

records.name: SalesRep.com
records.tagline: Your AI sales rep: live prices, quotes & follow-ups 24/7
records.description: SalesRep is a virtual sales rep that sells for you 24/7. Pulls live prices & stock from Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, Meta Catalog or your own database/API • Answers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email, SMS and more • Sends product cards and quotes on the fly, in any channel • Follows up until the deal closes, with human takeover anytime • 30+ languages, auto-detected Full-featured from $39/mo. 21-day free trial, no credit card required.

records.name: Kudos 3.0
records.tagline: The AI that finds money you're missing and gets it back
records.description: Most money apps show you charts. Kudos does the work. Your home shows Your wins, one number for everything Kudos has earned or saved you, and your next best money move. Most people don't know their cards come with personalized offers they have to turn on by hand. Kudos activates them for you: about $800/yr in offers in early testing. Our AI also calls providers to lower your bills ($216/yr per negotiation) and cancels subscriptions you forgot ($247/yr each). You keep 100% of the savings.

records.name: Ancher 2.0
records.tagline: Turn everything you read and save into work you can ship
records.description: Ancher is an AI knowledge workspace that turns everything you read, watch, and save into work you can actually use. Capture articles, videos, PDFs, posts, and ideas without organizing folders. Ancher connects related knowledge, lets you search and ask questions across your sources, and helps turn what you've learned into research briefs, reports, presentations, and content in your own voice. Your saved knowledge becomes more useful every time you add to it.

records.name: Manifold MCP
records.tagline: SEO, AI answers, social, ads and leads data for your agent
records.description: Manifold gives your agent live data from every marketing channel, in one hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code. Find keywords one push from page one. See if ChatGPT and Gemini recommend you. Watch the TikToks winning your niche. Read your competitors’ live ads. Catch Reddit threads asking for what you make. Get verified emails for buyers looking right now. Ask in plain words and your agent does the work. No pile of tabs. Free to start.

records.name: Dropstone CLI
records.tagline: The self-learning coding agent for your terminal
records.description: Dropstone CLI is a coding agent that learns from you. It reads your repo, edits across files, runs commands and tests, and checks its work before it says it's done. Correct it once and it keeps the lesson across sessions. Pick Fast, Pro, or Heavy models, plan before it builds, and set which commands run, ask first, or are blocked. Add skills, custom agents, parallel subagents, and MCP tools. Comment on a GitHub issue and it opens a pull request. On every plan, including Free.

records.name: Knocket
records.tagline: Chat with visitors from your website or link
records.description: Makers need a way for visitors to reach them, and to reply without opening another dashboard. Paste one script tag and a chat bubble appears on any site, or publish a contact page for your bio. Visitors start typing with no account needed. Messages go to Telegram. Quote-reply and it appears on their screen, and the thread stays in your inbox. If you're away, they leave an email. An AI agent answers from your docs and hands off to you when it matters. Free, no credit card, live in minutes.

records.name: guilds.run
records.tagline: Create multi-agent workflows that you can trust
records.description: Open-source AI agent teams you can actually inspect. Debug every prompt, tool call, memory change, and agent interaction. Control permissions, edit context, and choose the model for each agent. Self-host for free. Stop guessing what your agents are doing.

records.name: Milepost
records.tagline: An iOS driving journal for your car, with an MCP server
records.description: Milepost is a driving journal for your car on iOS, with an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, and other compatible AI agents. Record routes, photos, notes, music, and moments in Roadbooks. Share with friends for reactions and comments, or send a public web link. Build your garage, collect city and state stamps in each car’s Stampbook, relive routes in 3D, and make animated shares and monthly recaps. Record for free; Pro unlocks older history, exports, and deeper insights.

records.name: Cube Forms
records.tagline: Forms that can be filled by agents
records.description: Cube forms are made for AI agents. Your agent can create a form and fill one in directly, over MCP or plain HTTP, from Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor or any agent. No browser, no CAPTCHA. People can still open the same link and step in anytime: check what the agent filled, change anything, or fill it themselves. Free. Sign-ups, waitlists, bug reports, sales inquiries, any form.

records.name: ExcaliClaw
records.tagline: Hand-drawn diagrams your AI agent can draw with you
records.description: ExcaliClaw is a collaborative workspace for hand-drawn diagrams. Organize them in collections, search instantly, share by link or by name, and draw together in real time. Its MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or VS Code create and edit diagrams for you. Generous free plan: 200 drawings and unlimited AI (MCP) use, no credit card. Paid plans from €9/month. Version history, trash and backup export included. English, Español, Français.

records.name: Scrape Anything by Context.dev
records.tagline: Turn any website into clean data with one API call.
records.description: Scrape Anything by Context lets you pull clean, usable data from the web without building or maintaining scraping infrastructure. Give Context a URL and it handles rendering, blocks, proxies, retries, and extraction—returning Markdown, HTML, screenshots, or structured data through one API.

records.name: Bearconnect 2.0
records.tagline: AI-Powered LinkedIn Platform for Content and Outreach
records.description: Bearconnect started as a LinkedIn outreach tool. With V2, it’s now a platform for both inbound and outbound on LinkedIn. Create and schedule content, find prospects from LinkedIn activity, and turn intent into conversations with AI-powered messaging. V2 also adds team workspaces, role-based access, Brand Voice, CRM integrations, and webhooks.

records.name: Base Code
records.tagline: Let your whole team build on your product
records.description: Base Code lets teams work directly on existing codebases from the browser. Connect GitHub, describe changes in plain language, preview them live, and send completed work through standard pull requests.

records.name: Qalami
records.tagline: Marks handwritten Arabic and English essays to your rubric
records.description: Qalami marks handwritten student writing. Photograph a class set of essays, or upload PDF and Word files, and it marks each paper against your own rubric and drafts the feedback. Every score comes with a quote from the pupil's writing, so you can see why. Nothing counts until you approve it. It reads Arabic handwriting as well as English, and the whole app works in both languages, right to left included. You can try one paper without an account at qalamiapp.com/try.

records.name: Gildframe Creative Studio
records.tagline: Premium AI-powered product imagery for brands that stand out
records.description: Gildframe Creative Studio creates premium AI-powered product imagery for skincare, beauty, fragrance and lifestyle brands. We deliver stunning, campaign-ready visuals without the expense of traditional photoshoots. From product launches to social media advertising, we help brands stand out with luxury-quality creative at accessible prices.

records.name: findaskill
records.tagline: find ai skills, find mcp servers, build agents, run them
records.description: A curated directory and workspace for autonomous AI agents. Search thousands of skills, discover official MCP servers, architect multi-step agents, and execute them with connected tools.

records.name: BudgetAIStudio
records.tagline: AI sales agent that calls, quotes and follows up for you
records.description: One AI agent runs your whole sales desk. It pulls leads from your CRM or website, calls each one in their language, qualifies them, sends the quote on WhatsApp, books the appointment and chases the reply. Junk is filtered, hot leads are handed to you the moment they are ready to pay. Built for small businesses in India: speaks 80+ languages, answers incoming calls 24/7, and costs ₹799 a month plus usage credits. No telecaller, no setup calls, cancel anytime.

records.name: Maya Tutor
records.tagline: AI private tutor that turns homework into a magical game
records.description: Maya is an AI private tutor for kids. Tell her what they're learning at school and she turns every lesson into a magical, playful world. Math, reading, science and English by grade level, in 11 languages. Free to start, no credit card, no ads.

records.name: SMART MOSAIC for Mac
records.tagline: Hide faces and license plates in videos, right on your Mac
records.description: SMART MOSAIC for Mac automatically detects and tracks faces and license plates in videos, applying adjustable mosaic masks before you share. Processing happens on your Mac; your videos are not uploaded. Add manual tracking boxes or keep selected people visible, and export with the original audio. Free exports support videos up to 60 seconds with a watermark. Pro removes the time limit and watermark. No ads or account required.

records.name: Cliptate
records.tagline: On-device AI for Mac audio and video creators
records.description: Cliptate is a free, open-source macOS workspace for audio and video creators. Transcribe files, dictate text, trim silence, identify speakers, and synthesize or clone voices with speech models running on your Mac. Export captions as SRT, ASS, or VTT and timelines as FCPXML. Built for Apple Silicon, with optional AI correction and translation providers.

records.name: Bulin 47 AI Video Generator
records.tagline: Make Your Own Viral Freestyle
records.description: Create your own Bulin 47-inspired AI video from one photo. Choose your quality, generate a freestyle remix, and download your vertical MP4.

records.name: Mole Personal Safety Engine
records.tagline: An invisible AI bodyguard in your pocket.
records.description: Mole is an offline personal safety engine by Modach Technologies. Using 0 MB of data, it converts smartphone sensors into a security grid. Mole automatically detects device thefts via motion tracking and screams via acoustic analytics. Vocally confirmed emergencies instantly trigger an automated voice call to 112 and activate an offline Bluetooth tracking mesh showing nearby helpers landmark directions.

records.name: P-urpose
records.tagline: Yoga class planning and sequencing tool for teachers
records.description: P-urpose is a yoga class planning and sequencing tool for yoga teachers. Choose a purpose (e.g. hip opening, back care), style, duration (30–90 min) and level, and it builds a complete, timed class from 126 curated poses: warm-up before effort, left and right balanced, a calm ending. Edit it, teach from your phone in Teacher Mode, save it, export a PDF. Rule-based sequencing, no generative AI. Free: 3 classes/month. Pro: €8.99/month or €69/year. English and German. Made by Ichii GmbH, Berlin.

records.name: ACK card
records.tagline: 3–4% APY on your balance. 0.5–1% back on purchases. $0 fees.
records.description: The ACK card is a Visa/Mastercard debit card that accepts any currency or stablecoin, with 0% FX markup anywhere in the world. Digital or physical — your choice. - $0 card fee — No issuing, monthly or annual fee - 3–4% APY — Annual interest on your entire balance, every day - 0.5–1% cashback — On everything you buy - No minimums — No minimum balance. No minimum spend. ACK Fintech Inc. is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services are provided by a partner bank.

records.name: Pathey — One Goal, Every Route, Ranked.
records.tagline: Know the Odds on Every Investment. Not Advice, Just the Math
records.description: Pathey shows the odds on every investment, the way a prediction market shows the odds on a football game. ETFs, T-bills, options and prediction markets on one list, sorted by probability. Set a goal and a deadline, and see every way to hit it. Filter by asset class, chance of success, capital-safe or all-or-nothing, biggest return or smallest stake. Each option is scored on what you care about.

records.name: Deecoda
records.tagline: Grow your skills. Unlock your earning potential.
records.description: Turn your developer skills into growth and earning potential. Take on story-driven challenges, sharpen your technical thinking, and climb the ranks from Intern to Staff Engineer. Every task is an opportunity to level up your skills, earn rewards, and unlock your earning potential. Free to start. Built for developers ready to grow and earn.

records.name: RepPharma
records.tagline: The CRM for pharma field teams, from $20 a user
records.description: RepPharma is the CRM for pharma field teams. Reps log doctor and pharmacy visits in seconds on an app that works with no signal. Managers approve monthly plans in one click and follow targets, forecasts graded against real sales, samples, expenses and distributor stock in one place. It comes loaded with a directory of doctors, clinics, hospitals and pharmacies, works in your currency and working week, and has a published price: $20 or $40 per user a month.

records.name: Nightscape Stacker
records.tagline: Stack fixed-tripod nightscapes locally in your browser
records.description: Stack short, fixed-tripod nightscapes locally in desktop Chrome or Edge. Mark the sky and inspect at 100% for free. Manually blend a matching foreground or feather a local sky exposure. Full-resolution 16-bit TIFF export: $19.99 USD once for Browser Version 1, plus tax. Use 3–30 prepared sRGB JPEG/PNG or supported RGB TIFF frames, up to 32 MP each; develop RAW first. Alignment can fail. No automatic branch separation or color matching.

records.name: MyMindTherapyFriend AI-Mental Wellness
records.tagline: Your AI Wellness Companion, With Human Care at Heart.
records.description: MyMindTherapyFriend makes mental wellness more accessible through AI-powered support, self-care tools, mood tracking, and connections to human professionals. Our mission is to help people build healthier habits, understand their emotions, and find appropriate support when they need it. We’re building a connected ecosystem for individuals, students, therapists, and organizations with responsible AI and human care at its heart.

records.name: DBJoy
records.tagline: An AI-first native macOS client for PostgreSQL
records.description: DBJoy is a beautiful, lightweight, and fully featured macOS postgres client. Ask an AI assistant or Claude Code about your data (MCP Server). Browse tables, follow foreign keys, and see an ER diagram. Compare schemas and generate migrations.

records.name: Accurate Scheduler
records.tagline: Online appointment scheduling made simple for every business
records.description: Accurate Scheduler makes online appointment booking simple for businesses of all sizes. Create customizable booking pages, manage unlimited staff and services, accept online payments, and organize schedules in one place. Perfect for salons, spas, healthcare, fitness, consultants, and more. Get started with a free plan and grow with flexible scheduling tools designed to save time, reduce manual work, and deliver a better booking experience.

records.name: SvaraCall
records.tagline: Voice AI that cuts manual calling and responds in seconds
records.description: SvaraCall builds AI voice agents that make and answer business calls: lead follow-ups, appointment booking, reminders, and support triage. Powered by Cartesia for low-latency speech and Claude for reasoning, the agents sound natural, handle interruptions, and hand off to a human when needed. Built for startups and small businesses that want to cut manual calling and reach every lead in seconds. Now running our first pilot program.

records.name: QuantMetricsLabs
records.tagline: Institutional-Grade Single-Screen Portfolio Risk Terminal
records.description: QuantMetricsLabs is a single-screen portfolio risk terminal for investors and wealth managers. Run 1,000+ path Monte Carlo simulations, stress-test allocations against historical crises (2008 Crisis, Flash Crashes), analyze asset correlation matrices, overlay standard benchmarks (SPY, QQQ, AGG), and export 1-page executive PDF risk reports in one click.

records.name: NeverLackSMM
records.tagline: Social Media
records.description: Introducing **NeverLackSMM**, a next-generation SMM panel built for individuals, businesses, and resellers worldwide. Our platform offers a wide range of social media marketing services for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and more. With competitive pricing, a user-friendly dashboard, automated ordering, flexible payment options, API integration, and 24/7 customer support, NeverLackSMM delivers a faster, simpler, and more efficient experience for managing social media neverlacksmm.com

records.name: SaaS Scout
records.tagline: Spot rising demand before everyone else builds for it
records.description: SaaS Scout is a daily demand report for indie builders. Every day at 03:00 UTC it brings together early signs of new demand: searches climbing on Google, new pages pulling traffic on large sites, fresh listings on AI tool directories, products gaining paying users, new store listings and games taking off on itch.io or Show HN. Each opportunity is measured against a fixed baseline, checked against Google's first page for competition, and ends with a concrete next step.

records.name: UVShield: UV Index Alerts & Sunscreen
records.tagline: Free on Google Play live UV alerts and custom timers
records.description: The UVShield App is family focused and risk reduction focused to lower risk of sunburn and long-term melanoma risks. I also donate 10% of all ad and subscription profits to melanoma research every year. Key Features: - Live UV Index Alerts - Sunscreen reapply, sun exposure, and custom timers -Add family & friend #s to set timers and send reminders to loved ones -Skin tone selection for accurate burn estimates -Search any location and see the 12-hr forecast

records.name: AssetCalcs
records.tagline: Clean, ad-free real estate & business tax calculators
records.description: Most real estate & tax calculators are buried under ads, popups, and email gates. AssetCalcs is a clean, lightning-fast suite of underwriting tools built for investors and founders. • 100% Free & Ad-Free: Zero signups or lead forms • US Real Estate: DSCR loans, BRRRR, Hard Money & Cap Rates • US Tax: Section 179 vehicle deductions, LLC vs S-Corp • UK Property: Buy-to-Let mortgages & Bridging finance All calculations run instantly in your browser with institutional accuracy.

records.name: Agent Collab Kit
records.tagline: Local mailboxes and cooperative leases for AI agents
records.description: Coordinate agents on one trusted machine with a small Python standard-library CLI: durable SQLite messages, explicit acknowledgements, idempotency keys and expiring leases for exact resource names. Includes isolated tests and a supervised agent-improvement method. MIT licensed; no cloud, API key or agent framework. Cooperative coordination only: it does not authenticate agents, lock files or authorize real-world actions. By Kanibal Studio / Altavista360.

records.name: GenerujTo
records.tagline: 12 free browser-based generators and text tools, in Polish
records.description: 12 free generators in one place, with a Polish interface. Everything runs in your browser: no sign-up, and passwords, PINs, texts and QR data never leave your device. The font generator keeps Polish letters (ą, ć, ę, ł), the QR tool makes Wi-Fi, email and contact codes (PNG or SVG), and the color tool shows HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK and contrast checks. Also: password, PIN and number generators, team builder, random picker, character counter. Light and dark theme, mobile friendly.

records.name: TTSMint
records.tagline: Multilingual text to speech with audio and subtitle exports
records.description: TTSMint turns text into speech with 39 curated voices across English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish. Adjust speed, volume and pitch, then export MP3 audio and matching SRT or WebVTT subtitles. Voice previews are available without login; custom generation and downloads need an account. Paid subscriptions and credit packs are available, with 40 one-time trial credits for new users.

records.name: Zyris AI for Developers
records.tagline: Build AI apps that can search understand & reason over video
records.description: Zyris gives developers APIs and SDKs to build applications that understand video. Upload video, search moments using natural language, ask questions about video, generate embeddings and build video-native AI workflows through REST APIs, Python or Node.js SDKs. Instead of building the entire video understanding stack from scratch, developers can plug Zyris into their applications and start building.

records.name: PixVibe
records.tagline: Private image tools — AI that runs on your device
records.description: PixVibe is a set of free image tools where the AI runs on your own device, so your photos are never uploaded, stored, or used to train anyone's AI. Remove backgrounds, convert HEIC, AVIF and TIFF, compress to an exact KB size, resize, crop and upscale. Batch up to 20 images at once with a free account, no watermarks. Works on your phone too, then save the whole batch to your camera roll in one tap. For tough cutouts, Cloud refine runs a stronger model on our servers for credits.

records.name: Meteor
records.tagline: The AI agent that finds jobs, tailors resumes, and applies
records.description: Meteor turns repetitive job applications into one connected workflow. Find roles that fit your profile, tailor your resume to each opportunity, apply through supported employer portals, and track submissions and responses. Built for students, recent graduates, international students, and professionals who want more time for networking and interviews. Start with a free plan.

records.name: TensorDrill
records.tagline: Free AI coding challenges with interactive visual solutions
records.description: Learn modern AI by implementing it. TensorDrill offers 100 free Python challenges across Transformers, diffusion, Flow Matching, LLM systems, agents and world models. Write, run and submit code in your browser with test feedback. Explore full solutions, selected interactive visual explanations and curated links to blogs, papers and videos. English and Chinese. No signup, GPU or API key required.

records.name: PineBag — Portfolio Backtesting
records.tagline: PineBag is a portfolio backtest tool for TradingView.
records.description: Run one Pine Script strategy across up to 500 TradingView symbols and study the whole portfolio in one report.

records.name: HOAFineCheck
records.tagline: Dispute and dismiss abusive HOA fines in 90 seconds
records.description: Over 82% of HOA fines violate state procedural laws. Instead of paying a $2,500 lawyer retainer for a $150 citation, HOAFineCheck analyzes your notice and generates litigation-grade statutory defense packages in 90 seconds. Features: • All 50 US states & DC statutes covered • USPS Certified Mail dispute brief • 3-min executive board hearing script • Mandatory books & records audit demand • Freezes fine accruals under state law • 7-day 100% money-back guarantee

records.name: AiCanvasly
records.tagline: Turn text into editable decks, posters & storyboards
records.description: AiCanvasly turns text and outlines into editable HTML presentations, AI posters, and structured storyboard shot lists. Revise the structure before rendering, with editorial or Swiss grid styles. Present and share decks in the browser, or export editable PPTX. Posters export to PNG or HTML; storyboards export a Shot List CSV. Built for content that keeps changing.

records.name: Sea Imagine AI
records.tagline: Create AI images and videos from text or photos
records.description: Sea Imagine AI brings AI image and video creation into one online workspace. Generate images and videos from text prompts or uploaded images, animate still photos, and use tools for editing, avatars, lip-sync, background removal, and photo restoration. Start with free credits; one-time paid credit packs are available.

records.name: Teleprompter: Read to Camera
records.tagline: Read scripts over your iPhone camera, rehearse, then record
records.description: An iPhone teleprompter with transparent scrolling text over the front camera. Try free, unrecorded practice, adjust your pace, then record video without the prompt in the saved take. Scripts and drafts stay on-device; no account. Recording/export access varies and may require paid Pro; monthly and lifetime options are available. AI tools assisted development and this launch copy. Gallery portraits are fictional illustrations, not customer footage.

records.name: Memento
records.tagline: Encrypted notes, passwords & links. Only you hold the keys.
records.description: Memento is a privacy-first workspace for notes, passwords, bookmarks and AI prompts. Notes, vault items, prompts and attachments are encrypted on your device with XChaCha20-Poly1305 before they sync, so our servers never see that content in plaintext. One app instead of three: Markdown editor, credential vault and smart link previews. Free during public beta. Next up: Claude-powered semantic search, summaries and tag suggestions that run on client-decrypted content.

records.name: Open Lingo
records.tagline: Learn Korean, Japanese, French, and Spanish for free
records.description: Open Lingo - A free to use language learning app, teaching: Korean, Japanese, French, and Spanish My brother and I have been working on Open Lingo for a while, after deciding Duolingo did not offer good vocab & grammar practice, and was really expensive. We're a transit themed, SLA science (second-language acquisition) based language learning app. Our courses are authored with word frequency in mind so you can learn words you're likely to hear.

records.name: DSAR Management
records.tagline: Access, correction & erasure requests, handled on time.
records.description: **Kensara DSAR Management** handles access, erasure, correction, portability and opt-out requests under DPDPA, GDPR and CCPA in one governed, seven-stage workflow with SLA timers. It finds a person's data across your databases and SaaS tools, runs erasures after a legal hold check, verifies deletion and issues certificates. AI drafts and predicts, but legal decisions come only from rules or a named human. Every action is logged in a tamper evident audit trail.

records.name: Drake Burning Bridges AI Video Generator
records.tagline: Turn one photo into the center of a Burning Bridges video.
records.description: Drake Burning Bridges AI turns one clear photo into an 18-second, share-ready party video. It rebuilds the take around your face and outfit while preserving the room, camera energy, and original sound. Upload a photo, let AI prepare your portrait, then generate and download your MP4 in minutes. There are no subscriptions: packs start at $9.90, credits never expire, and failed generations are automatically refunded. Independent fan-made project, not affiliated with Drake or OVO Sound.

records.name: Tutorlin
records.tagline: Transform your study files into AI quizzes, notes & maps
records.description: Tutorlin is an AI-powered study platform that helps you beat doomscrolling and get your focus back. Upload your PDFs or notes to instantly generate custom interactive quizzes, smart summaries, flashcards and structured study maps. Study smarter with Active Recall.

records.name: Carpets Online
records.tagline: Dreams Pewter Anthracite 20mm Thick Carpet
records.description: The Dreams Pewter Anthracite Carpet combines a deep grey anthracite shade with a luxurious 20mm thick pile. Made from 100% polyester with super-soft yarn and high-density 1/10 gauge construction, it offers a comfortable feel underfoot while remaining stain resistant and easy to clean. It has dual backing, is suitable for heavy domestic use and can be used with underfloor heating. Available in a 4m width with a 10-year warranty.

records.name: Burning Bridges AI
records.tagline: Turn one pet photo into a 15-second party video
records.description: Burning Bridges AI puts your pet into a fixed 15-second party scene from one photo. Pick landscape or vertical. No prompt writing, no timeline, and no extra setup. The first version keeps the motion and soundtrack fixed.

records.name: HideNStick Notes
records.tagline: Sticky notes that hide on your Windows screen edge
records.description: Most sticky notes cover your work. HideNStick Notes lives in a slim rail on the edge of your Windows screen instead. Hover a tab to write, pin notes over any app, then tuck everything away. Hide the rail completely and bump the edge twice (or press Ctrl+Alt+N) to bring it back. Grab text from any app with Ctrl+Alt+C and search every note with Ctrl+F. No account, no cloud, works fully offline. Early bird: 50% off at launch.

records.name: Beadsvenue
records.tagline: Swarovski 5810 Iridescent Dove Grey 12mm Pearls
records.description: product price :- A$12.93 Description:- Shop Swarovski 5810 Iridescent Dove Grey 12mm round crystal pearls at BeadsVenue. Ideal for handmade necklaces, bracelets, bridal jewellery, earrings and creative jewellery-making projects.

records.name: Carpets Online
records.tagline: Satino Royale Iron Grey Saxony Carpet | Soft & Luxurious
records.description: Add a stylish, sophisticated look to your home with the Satino Royale Iron Grey Saxony Carpet. Its rich iron grey shade and soft Saxony pile create a comfortable, luxurious feel underfoot, making it a great choice for bedrooms, living rooms and other relaxing spaces. Its plush finish offers a good balance of comfort and everyday practicality. For underfloor heating, always check the product’s individual TOG rating and the combined carpet and underlay rating before installation.

It downloads every document filed in your cases from the court e-filing portals (CE-File in England & Wales; EFS and EKSS in Malaysia), numbered in filing order and dated. The portals allow this only by hand, one document at a time. It also builds paginated, bookmarked court bundles and the index in Word, and writes bundle page numbers back into your skeleton argument. Runs on your computer. No generative AI.

records.name: SEO Report!
records.tagline: seo, seo-audit, seo-checker, website-analysis
records.description: SEO Report! is a free, browser-based SEO analysis tool. Enter a URL and it checks the page's on-page SEO, gives an overall score out of 100, and shows a prioritized list of issues to fix.

records.name: Rentalot
records.tagline: The AI Agent for Leasing Agents
records.description: Rentalot is an AI assistant for leasing agents and property managers. 🎙️ AI voice screening: renters call or text through one link and answer your screening questions. 💬 Chat with AI to manage everything: "add this listing," "who toured 12 Oak St?", "move Sarah's showing to Friday." 📅 Showings go straight onto your calendar. You approve what matters.

records.name: Kinhin
records.tagline: Turn your Mac into an autoscaling CI runner pool
records.description: The mindful CI — autoscaling CI runners that live on your Mac. macOS jobs on Tart VMs, Linux jobs on apple/container microVMs or Docker.

records.name: Burrr.io
records.tagline: Drills hunt each other underground by engine sound
records.description: A free multiplayer browser game: you're a drill inside a round planet. Nobody is seen underground, but every engine is heard through the rock, so kill yours and wait in the dark. Free-for-all, capture the flag, hide and seek. Desktop and phones, no sign-up.

records.name: Oktoprism
records.tagline: Ship your startup in days, not weeks
records.description: The production ready Next.js SaaS starter with everything you need to get your product in front of customers. From idea to production in 10 minutes.

records.name: CaseRound
records.tagline: Mock case interviews out loud, with an AI that pushes back
records.description: Practice mock case interviews out loud with a live AI interviewer, on curated MBB-style cases or your own case PDFs. 8-dimension feedback. First interview free, no card needed.

records.name: Not yet.
records.tagline: Beautiful countdowns, free widgets, and memories
records.description: Count down to trips, birthdays, and the days you can't wait for. Not yet turns each moment into a personal countdown with different faces and your own photos. Every widget and size is free, with no ads or account needed for local use. Save photos and notes while you wait, import dates from your calendar, set reminders, and share a countdown with friends. Available on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android. Optional Plus unlocks all faces and more cloud photo storage.

records.name: Free SEO Audit
records.tagline: Is your website leaking customers? Find out in 45 seconds.
records.description: Free SEO audit tool — 21 checks across crawl, content, technical and deep signals. Instant score out of 100 with plain-English fixes. No signup required.

records.name: SkyScope
records.tagline: Daily astrology app for daily quizzes, mood and a streak
records.description: SkyScope: a daily star sign reading, a new quiz every day, streaks and daily mood alerts.

records.name: Wist
records.tagline: Create Windows custom widgets for your own applications.
records.description: Customize your Windows desktop with Wist. Create your own widgets or use the Wist SDK to connect your apps and bring their content and controls directly to your desktop.

records.name: Fazoli's Menu
records.tagline: Spaghetti with Marinara · Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
records.description: Explore the updated Fazoli's Menu 2026 with prices, calories, nutrition facts, pasta, pizza, Italian deals, family meals, desserts and more.

records.name: Melodic Sampler
records.tagline: Turn recordings and samples into playable musical ideas
records.description: Turn a sound into an instrument. Record or import samples, edit the source, build sampler racks, and layer sounds into beats and textures. Shape playback with dynamic sampling controls and effects, then record and export sampled clips for your next production. Melodic Sampler is built for beatmakers, sound designers and live experimentation on web, iOS and Android. Start with free features and unlock more through optional paid upgrades.

records.name: NOT Networks
records.tagline: Monitor, map, and manage your network without the busywork.
records.description: Meet NOT Networks — a simpler way to monitor, search, map, and understand your network. NOT helps teams troubleshoot and track device status, while NAP turns network inventory into a live, searchable map. Starting with Aruba Central, with more vendor integrations planned. Built to reduce manual searching and give network teams faster visibility into what matters.

records.name: Quantral
records.tagline: Investment ideas app built on alternative data
records.description: Quantral is an investment ideas app built on alternative data. It tracks what finance X, Reddit, YouTube and Substack are saying, what members of Congress are trading, and which company insiders are buying their own stock. Every company gets a 0-100 score, and every voice making a call gets graded on their real track record. Strategies turn the same data into model portfolios you can follow and compare against the S&P 500. On iPhone, Android, the web, and inside Claude and ChatGPT.

records.name: PrintPageCheck
records.tagline: Free printer test pages for color, text, and alignmen
records.description: Print a free printer test page to check colors, grayscale, text, and margins. Print online or download A4 and US Letter PDFs. No signup needed.

records.name: PdfWord
records.tagline: 47 Free PDF Tools Online - No Signup, No Watermark
records.description: Free online PDF tools - merge, split, compress, convert PDF to Word/Excel/PowerPoint, edit, eSign, OCR, plus 11 AI tools (summarizer, chat with PDF, contract checker). Everything runs in your browser. No signup, no watermark, $0/month.
